shortDescription: Downloads software from the SAP Software Center.

options.name: deduplicate
options.description: Specifies how to handle multiple search results. Only applies when C(search_alternatives) is enabled and multiple versions are found. Choices: C(first) returns the oldest version, C(last) returns the newest version. If left empty and multiple results are found, an error with all available versions will be displayed.

options.name: download_filename
options.description: Download filename of the SAP software.

options.name: download_link
options.description: Direct download link to the SAP software.

options.name: dry_run
options.description: Check availability of SAP Software without downloading.

options.name: search_alternatives
options.description: Enable search for alternative packages when the exact filename is not available. Required when using wildcard queries in C(search_query). Only works for files following the format C(PREFIX-ID.EXT) with a dash and extension. Special media files without this pattern (e.g., C(S4CORE107_INST_EXPORT_1.zip)) must use exact filenames.

options.name: search_query
options.description: Filename of the SAP software to download. Supports wildcard format for version matching with C(search_alternatives) enabled. Wildcard format: C(PREFIX*-ID.EXT) where the asterisk replaces the version number. Example: C(SWPM20SP2*-80003424.SAR) matches all versions like SWPM20SP23, SWPM20SP24, etc. Only one wildcard is allowed per query.

options.name: search_upgrades
options.description: Enable broader search to find any available version in the product family. Only applies when C(search_alternatives) is enabled. Useful when specific versions are removed from SAP Software Center (e.g., old HANA revisions). Example: searching for C(IMDB_SERVER20_067_4) may find C(IMDB_SERVER20_080_0) if 067 is no longer available. Typically combined with C(deduplicate='last') to get the newest available version.

options.name: validate_checksum
options.description: If a file with the same name already exists at the destination, validate its checksum against the remote file. If the checksum is invalid, the local file will be removed and re-downloaded.
